title: Peter RAIDL
text:
When I started school, I wanted to become a writer or scientist. Now, I finally found the courage to be just that. It’s scary!
I hold a PhD in Sport and Human Movement Science from the University of Vienna and a BSc degree in Physiotherapy. I have broad interests in training and exercise science for health and performance, and feel drawn to psychology and philosophy, even though I have no special training in either.
Embodymate was originally created in 2015 and developed into a loose collaboration between a Psychotherapist (Chris) and an exercise scientist and physiotherapist (Peter). The founders’ professional paths diverged a bit. In case you are missing any older content or are interested in psychotherapy, please contact my beloved colleague Christoph Humnig directly.
